Asset type: production-ready portrait 9:16 full-bleed BACKGROUND image for Glide, a tiny origami bird side-scrolling game.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production game sprite for Glide. This will be shown only 35 world pixels across its longest side, around a shared 28px diameter collision circle.
Art style: clean simple origami sprite, a small number of broad flat paper polygons, sparse bold fold seams, dark charcoal outlines, restrained flat shading. Same family as a folded paper toucan. Not realistic, no fine feathers, no grain noise.
CRITICAL shape constraints: compact silhouette, width about 1.1 to 1.25 times height (except trophy/lantern which may be square). Main body centred, short extremities, no huge sweeping wings. Keep the entire object inside a square canvas with generous even transparent margins.
CRITICAL color coding for two-layer recoloring: ALL BODY areas must be strictly neutral LIGHT GRAY (#eeeeee, #cccccc, #999999 fold shadows), with neutral dark-gray details and charcoal #202020 outlines. Only designated ACCENT areas are warm GOLDEN ORANGE (#ffa000 with #d88500 shading). NO other hues. Do not use any fixed red, blue, pink or green. Accent region must be enclosed by a dark outline.
Background: REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside the sprite. Not a gray or white field, not a rendered checkerboard. No cast shadow, no glow, no scene, no floor, no UI, no letters, no logos, no watermark. ONE sprite only, no panels.

Dark gray wing panels within the neutral grayscale body. A stork, not a crane with a long trailing neck.
